design_issues.screen: Pusat Pengaturan — Kebijakan Retur Jual (Semua Entitas)
issues: In 'Semua Entitas' view-only mode the cutloss/discount Hitung button still fires but backend returns 409; UI already shows a red hint 'Mode Semua Entitas hanya untuk melihat gabungan ... pilih dulu badan usaha'. Could disable the button in view-only mode for clarity (same minor remark as iter227 for templates).

critical_code_review_comments: return_exception_service.py: enforces attachment_ids ⊆ return.attachments AND type startswith image/ before accepting a 'condition' or 'discount_no_goods' exception; approve blocked if requester == decider (same_user_decide 400). Clean separation of policy_eligibility.pending_decisions from exception approval set — matches the ReturnSettlementPolicy gate 409 contract on /settle.

return_service._create_credit_note_and_post_gl: bill-first splits ar_applied = min(gross, open_bill) and excess_amount → cash/store_credit; GL post_sales_return credits 1-1200 for ar_part and refund/store_credit account for the rest. Setting returns.bill_first default True from DEFAULT_GLOBAL_SETTINGS — toggle respected end-to-end (tested t01).

Cutloss simulator (returns.cutloss_simulate) returns 3 scenarios with reconciles True and selected=null + posting_locked=true while KLR-01/02 pending — exactly the configurable-assumption behaviour. Discount simulator returns stock_movement 0 and requires_exception True whenever settings.returns.discount_mode == pending.

interco_service.job_interco_payment_reminder dedupes per (interco_id:pay_date) via notifications.sent_once_key and emits for finance of payer entity within settings.interco_payment.reminder_days (default 3); exits early when cutoff pending. UI exposes interco-reminder-days input tied to settings.interco_payment via /api/config/values.

CreateReturnForm.jsx POSTs hangtag_missing / cut_by_customer via SalesReturnCreate schema; eligibility preview re-fetches via /api/sales-returns/eligibility with those flags → matches backend_schema SalesReturnCreate fields and condition_flags storage.
